data.name: Fly High Runners
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Fly High Club, Vibe City’s mostly legal jetpack courier service!

Manage your contraband inventory, be the first to snatch up orders and keep your fuel in check. The courier with the biggest profit at the end of the 8:40 round earns bragging rights as Runner of the Night!

KEY FEATURES

The Flight System

Pilot a janky, fuel-powered jetpack by tapping at the right moment and make inertia your friend, not your enemy! Run out of gas and you’ll drop like a sack of bricks, but overfill it and you’ll fly like one.

The G-Boots Feint

Tap your G-Boots to dive faster. Perfect for dodging drones, stealing deliveries, or holding on for dear life when your buddy tries to nudge you off a platform.

Smuggle High-Profit Contraband

Manage your stash of classic fan-favorite weed, reliable mid-tier shrooms, and high-value exotic microchips. Stay on the look out for reseller offers with juicy discounts. Whatever you do, don't let the night end with left over product!

Cutthroat Jetpack Combat

Wipe out your rivals with a perfectly timed EMP blast! Disable their jetpacks midair and watch them plummet while you spam the "MINE MINE MINE" emote. EMP hits also have a chance to dislodge one of their products, so add insult to injury by swooping in and stealing it!

Dodge the Cops

Police drones are always paroling the skies. Fly too close and you’ll be scanned. Get caught with more than the legal limit and you’re getting stripped of your extra goods (and your dreams of getting Runner of the Night).

Power-Up your deliveries

Hunt down Power-Up Drones through the skyscrapers to receive temporary boosts such as invisibility, EMP immunity and discounts, or nasty debuffs to unleash on others. Tag a rival with an EMP to pass along the pain of inverted controls, no GPS or a fuel leak.

Last Minute Pawn Shop

End game event: get rid of your unsold inventory, as long as you respect the queue (nobody does!).

Solo Queue, Private Solo Lobby, Private Team Lobby

Jump straight into the mayhem via quick play (disabled in demo) or set up a password-protected private lobby for your crew. 
Or try our new team 2v2 or 3v3 game modes!

The little things

  • The Lobby - No need to jump into the chaos with a cold engine. Gather your friends, learn the ropes of flying and delivering quests in The Lobby (Sponsored by Yuri's Chop Shop)

  • Social Feed - Check your social feed for in-game posts that keep the world feeling alive. Laugh, cry and learn about conspiracies from the colorful people of Vibe City.

  • Spam Emotes - Rub it in! Use a variety of emotes to grief your friends after a successful delivery steal.

  • Catch a Vibe - The city lights pulse with the synthwave beats of the radio (literally!). Flip through the custom in-game playlist to find your favorite tunes.

  • Customize your runner - Customize your character's outfit to look good while breaking the law.

Ready to take flight and win Runner of the Night super exclusive title?

data.short_description: Race against up to five frenemies as jetpack couriers trying to deliver contraband through a pulsing cyberpunk skyline. Master the questionably-engineered flight system, manage fuel & inventory, collect power-ups and EMP blast rivals into cop drones.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th Gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 3 equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD equivalent with OpenGL 3.3+ support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th Gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 5 equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 / Steam Deck equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th Gen) / Apple M1 equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics / Apple integrated GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th Gen) / Apple M1 or newer
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple integrated GPU (M1/M2) / discrete GPU equivalent to NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Fly High Runners is a colorful party platformer with retro cyberpunk vibes and non-realistic, non-graphic gameplay. Players compete to deliver "cyberpunk contraband" items (chip implants, mushrooms, and weed). These items function strictly as inventory tokens used for scoring; there is no visual depiction of consumption.

Player interactions involve mild cartoon-style combat using EMP bursts that temporarily knock opponents away or cause effects such as reversed controls, invisibility or dropping held items. The core experience centers on outsmarting and sabotaging your frenemies on aerial delivery routes. 

There is no depiction of injury, blood or death, and the tone remains light-hearted and comedic throughout.
